newsitem.title: USA: Honda to make plant announcement Monday.
newsitem.headline: Honda to make plant announcement Monday.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said Friday it will make a manufacturing plant announcement Monday, which local officials have described as a $40 million facility to make all-terrain vehicles and personal watercraft.
Honda's North American unit said the announcement will be made at the Florence City-County Civic Center in Florence, S.C. at 1500 EDT/1900 GMT May 5.

Honda officials have not disclosed details of the plant, other than to say it is not involved in the auto industry. But Henry Peoples, mayor of nearby Timmonsville, S.C., said Thursday the plant will be built in five phases, with the first employing about 600 people.
The first-phase products will include the watercraft and motorcycle-like ATVs. Peoples said Honda has not disclosed products for later phases of the facility.

Also, South Carolina Sen. Ernest Hollings, a Democrat, discused the plant during a meeting of the Senate Commerce Committee earlier this week. His office said the facility would employ about 700 people.
